output.scope_note: The paper is about ML prediction of NASICON/SICON ionic conductivity, but the text gives no conductivity value for any specific material; the only numbers are a dataset-wide range (10^-3 to 10^-13 S cm-1) and a classification threshold (1 × 10^-6 S cm-1), and the per-material values are only in supplementary Table S1a/S1b, which is not included.
